# Run: bundle exec ruby -Ilib spec/fixtures/sdr/lora/benchmark.txt
require 'pwn'
require 'json'
require 'zlib'
root = File.dirname(__FILE__)
results = JSON.parse(File.read("#{root}/modes.json"), symbolize_names: true).map do |v|
  iq = Zlib::GzipReader.open("#{root}/#{v[:file]}", &:read).unpack('e*')
  options = v.slice(:sf, :bw, :implicit_header, :payload_length, :cr, :crc, :ldro, :invert_iq)
  frames = []
  demod = PWN::SDR::Decoder::LoRa::PayloadIQ.new(**options, rate: v[:sample_rate])
  started = Process.clock_gettime(Process::CLOCK_MONOTONIC)
  iq.each_slice(8192) { |chunk| demod.feed_iq(chunk) { |frame| frames << frame } }
  elapsed = Process.clock_gettime(Process::CLOCK_MONOTONIC) - started
  raise 'decode mismatch' unless frames.length == 1 && frames.first[:payload_hex] == v[:payload_hex]
  duration = iq.length.fdiv(2 * v[:sample_rate])
  { file: v[:file], sf: v[:sf], sample_rate: v[:sample_rate], samples: iq.length / 2,
    seconds: elapsed.round(6), signal_seconds: duration.round(6),
    realtime_ratio: (duration / elapsed).round(3), decoded_packets: frames.length }
end
puts JSON.pretty_generate(results)
